commit.message:
[grug] Honor Hero YaRN and BF16 router precision (#97)

Carry explicit YaRN scaling through Grug config serialization and rotary
construction, retaining partial rotation and the native Q/K amplitude.
Transformers aliases rope_scaling to rope_parameters, so assign the resolved
parameters once to preserve them when a config is reloaded.

Round Hero router dot outputs through the hidden-state dtype before FP32 QB
bias and expert selection. Keep the Snowball profile's existing precision.
CPU config and rotary checks pass; full GPU model parity remains unverified.

commit.message: Support Hero ShortConv profiling in GPU runner V2

Preserve Snowball and Hero serving on vLLM 0.30.0

Replay the model, topology, capture and reload changes from Marin main
39e62869693c46402b1a95fde4fc55ca1aab9ae1 in their original order.
Keep GrugMoE routing, FP32 biases, BF16 projections, mixed attention,
pipeline and expert parallelism, checkpoint-coordinate weight transfer,
online EAGLE capture, reasoning parsing and layerwise storage release.
The upstream release still lacks these Marin model and deployment paths.

Keep upstream's new prefill context parallelism imports alongside Marin's
expert parallelism import. No Grug model or config payload changes from
the previously qualified main source are needed for this textual replay.

Drop model patches when upstream provides the corresponding GrugMoE
behavior, deployment patches when upstream supports Marin's native rank
placement and network constraints, and capture and reload patches when
upstream preserves the same training and weight-update contracts.
